bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to capital investment; appropriating money for bridge replacement in the city of Chokio; authorizing the sale and issuance of state bonds.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. [+STEVENS COUNTY; CHOKIO BRIDGE. +]

[+Subdivision 1.+]

[+Appropriation.+]

[+$290,000 is appropriated from the bond proceeds fund to the commissioner of transportation for a grant to Stevens County to design, construct, and equip the replacement of the Chokio Bridge on Stevens County State-Aid Highway 13 in the city of Chokio. +]

[+Subd. 2.+]

[+Bond sale.+]

[+To provide the money appropriated in this section from the bond proceeds fund, the commissioner of management and budget shall sell and issue bonds of the state in an amount up to $290,000 in the manner, upon the terms, and with the effect prescribed by Minnesota Statutes, sections 16A.631 to 16A.675, and by the Minnesota Constitution, article XI, sections 4 to 7. +]

[+EFFECTIVE DATE.+]

[+This section is effective the day following final enactment. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to capital investment; appropriating money for bridge replacement in the city of Chokio; authorizing the sale and issuance of state bonds.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. STEVENS COUNTY; CHOKIO BRIDGE.

Subdivision 1.

Appropriation.

$290,000 is appropriated from the bond proceeds fund to the commissioner of transportation for a grant to Stevens County to design, construct, and equip the replacement of the Chokio Bridge on Stevens County State-Aid Highway 13 in the city of Chokio.

Subd. 2.

Bond sale.

To provide the money appropriated in this section from the bond proceeds fund, the commissioner of management and budget shall sell and issue bonds of the state in an amount up to $290,000 in the manner, upon the terms, and with the effect prescribed by Minnesota Statutes, sections 16A.631 to 16A.675, and by the Minnesota Constitution, article XI, sections 4 to 7.

EFFECTIVE DATE.

This section is effective the day following final enactment.
additions: $290,000 is appropriated from the bond proceeds fund to the commissioner of transportation for a grant to Stevens County to design, construct, and equip the replacement of the Chokio Bridge on Stevens County State-Aid Highway 13 in the city of Chokio.

To provide the money appropriated in this section from the bond proceeds fund, the commissioner of management and budget shall sell and issue bonds of the state in an amount up to $290,000 in the manner, upon the terms, and with the effect prescribed by Minnesota Statutes, sections 16A.631 to 16A.675, and by the Minnesota Constitution, article XI, sections 4 to 7.
This section is effective the day following final enactment.
